column1: resource§The only resource the department had was nine people who knew the system, and four of them retired.§这个部门唯一的**资源**是九个懂这套系统的人，其中四个退休了。§re（再）+ surg（升起，同 surge 涌起）→ 再涌出来的东西
resourceful§The most resourceful person on the crew fixed the pump with a bicycle inner tube and four cable ties.§船员里最**足智多谋的**那位用一条自行车内胎和四根扎带修好了泵。§
respite§The respite lasted four weeks, and the same problem returned in a form nobody had planned for.§这段**喘息**持续了四周，同样的问题以无人预案的形式回来了。§re（回）+ spect（看，同 inspect 检查）→ 回头看一眼、缓一缓
resplendent§The resplendent ceiling took nine years to paint and was hidden by a false floor from 1908 to 1994.§这片**辉煌灿烂的**天花板画了九年，从 1908 到 1994 年被一层假楼板挡着。§re（加强）+ splend（发光，同 splendid 灿烂的）
responsible§Nobody was responsible for the whole process, and that is the report's central finding.§没有人对整个流程**负责**，这正是报告的核心结论。§re（回）+ spons（承诺，同 respond 回应）
restitution§Restitution was ordered in 1994 and, four appeals later, has still not been paid.§**归还赔偿**在 1994 年被判令，经过四次上诉至今仍未支付。§re（回）+ stitut（建立，同 constitute 构成）
restless§The ward grows restless around four in the morning, and the staffing is lightest at exactly that hour.§病区在凌晨四点左右变得**躁动不安**，而人手恰恰在那个钟点最少。§
restore§They restored the clock in nine months and could not restore the sound, which nobody had recorded.§他们用九个月**修复**了这座钟，却无法复原它的声音——没人录过。§re（再）+ stor ← staur（建立，同 store 储存）
restrain§Four colleagues restrained him from sending the email, and he thanked each of them separately.§四位同事**拦住**他没让他发出那封邮件，他分别向每人道了谢。§re（回）+ strain（拉紧，同 strict 严格的）
restraint§The restraint she showed in the hearing cost her nothing and won her the four votes she needed.§她在听证会上表现的**克制**没让她损失什么，却赢得了所需的四票。§
restriction§The restriction applies to four species and is enforced, in practice, on about one.§这项**限制**适用于四个物种，实际执行的约为一个。§re（回）+ strict（拉紧，同 strict 严格的）
restrictive§The covenant is restrictive to the point of absurdity: it forbids hanging washing on any Sunday.§这项契约**限制**得近乎荒唐——它禁止在任何周日晾晒衣物。§
resurgence§The resurgence took everyone by surprise: the same disease, in the same four districts, forty years later.§这次**卷土重来**让所有人措手不及——同样的疾病，同样的四个区，四十年之后。§re（再）+ surg（升起，同 surge 涌起）
resuscitation§Resuscitation was attempted for forty minutes, and the report notes that four minutes had already passed before anyone called.§**心肺复苏**尝试了四十分钟，报告指出在有人呼救前已经过了四分钟。§re（再）+ suscit（唤起）
retain§The firm retains four percent of its graduate hires past the third year, which nobody in it will discuss.§这家公司**留住**了百分之四的应届生超过第三年，而公司内部没人愿意谈这个。§re（回）+ tain（拿住，同 contain 容纳）
retentive§His remarkably retentive memory for numbers made him useful in meetings and, in four separate negotiations, decisive.§他对数字**记性极好**，这让他在会议上很有用，并在四次谈判中起了决定作用。§
reticence§Her reticence about her own work was so complete that colleagues learned of the prize from the newspaper.§她对自己工作的**缄默**如此彻底，同事是从报纸上得知她获奖的。§re（回）+ tic ← tac（沉默，同 tacit 心照不宣的）
reticent§The most reticent member of the panel wrote the dissent that four courts later adopted.§评审组里最**沉默寡言的**成员写下了异议，四家法院后来采纳了它。§
retraction§The retraction ran to four lines and appeared on page nineteen, and the original claim had led the front page.§这则**撤稿声明**只有四行，登在第十九页，而原先的说法曾是头版头条。§re（回）+ tract（拉，同 attract 吸引）
retrenchment§Retrenchment closed nine libraries, and the town is still counting what that cost a generation of children.§**紧缩**关掉了九座图书馆，这座小镇仍在计算它让一代孩子付出了什么。§re（回）+ trench（壕沟）→ 往回挖沟收缩
retrieve§Divers retrieved four of the eleven boxes, and the seven still down there hold the ship's log.§潜水员**取回**了十一个箱子中的四个，仍在下面的七个装着航海日志。§re（再）+ trov（找到）
retroactive§The change is retroactive to 1994, which means about nine thousand cases must now be reviewed.§这项改动**追溯至**1994 年，意味着约九千件案子现在必须复审。§retro（向后）+ act（行动）
retrograde§The move looked retrograde at the time and, four years later, is described as visionary.§这一步当时看着**倒退**，四年后被描述为有远见。§retro（向后）+ grad（走，同 progress 前进）
reveal§The photograph reveals four people in a room the official account says held only two.§这张照片**揭示**出屋里有四个人，而官方说法称只有两个。§re（去掉）+ veal ← vel（面纱，同 veil 面纱）
reverence§The reverence for the founder made it impossible to say, for forty years, that he had been wrong.§对创始人的**崇敬**让人四十年说不出他曾经错了。§re（加强）+ ver（敬畏）
reverential§The reverential tone of the biography is its main flaw, and its four hundred footnotes are its main virtue.§这部传记**充满敬意的**语调是它的主要缺陷，四百条脚注是它的主要优点。§
reversal§The reversal itself took nine minutes in court, and getting the case that far had taken four years.§**翻案**本身在法庭上用了九分钟，而把案子推到那一步用了四年。§
reverse§The court reversed a ruling that had stood for forty years and had been cited in nine hundred cases.§法院**推翻**了一项已立四十年、被九百桩案子引用过的裁定。§re（回）+ vers（转，同 convert 转变）
revise§She revised the chapter nine times and published, in the end, something close to the fourth version.§她把这一章**修改**了九次，最终发表的接近第四版。§re（再）+ vis（看，同 vision 视觉）
revisionist§The revisionist account is better documented than the standard one and is taught in about four universities.§这种**修正主义的**叙述比标准说法更有据可依，约四所大学在教它。§
revisit§The team revisited the site after nine years and found four of the markers had been removed.§团队九年后**重访**这处遗址，发现四个标记已被移走。§re（再）+ visit（访问）
revitalize§Four hundred thousand pounds revitalized a high street that nine planning documents had failed to help.§四十万英镑**振兴**了一条九份规划文件都没能帮上忙的商业街。§re（再）+ vital（生命的）
revivalist§The revivalist movement peaked in 1908 and left four buildings that are now the town's only landmarks.§这场**复兴运动**在 1908 年达到顶峰，留下四栋如今是镇上仅有的地标建筑。§
revive§One reprint revived interest in a writer who had been out of print for forty years.§一次重印**重新唤起**了人们对一位绝版四十年的作家的兴趣。§re（再）+ viv（生命，同 survive 幸存）
revoke§The authority revoked the licence in March and reinstated it, without explanation, four months later.§主管部门三月**吊销**了这份执照，四个月后不作解释地恢复了它。§re（回）+ voc（呼唤，同 voice 声音）→ 把话叫回去
revolutionize§Cheap sensors revolutionized the field in about four years and put nine specialist manufacturers out of business.§廉价传感器在约四年内**彻底改变**了这个领域，也让九家专业厂商倒闭。§
rhapsodize§Critics rhapsodized about the debut and, four years later, could not remember the author's name.§评论者对这部处女作**赞不绝口**，四年后却记不起作者的名字。§
rhetoric§The rhetoric promised nine hundred new homes, and the planning application asked for forty.§这番**言辞**许诺九百套新房，而规划申请只要求四十套。§
rhetorical§The question was rhetorical, and a first-year student answered it correctly, which changed the lecture.§这是个**修辞性的**问句，而一名一年级学生正确地回答了它，讲座因此改变。§
ridicule§Ridicule did more to end the practice than four separate pieces of legislation had.§**嘲笑**在终结这种做法上起的作用，超过四部单独的立法。§rid（笑，同 ridiculous 荒唐的）
rigidity§The rigidity of the timetable is what makes the system reliable and what makes it fail in bad weather.§时刻表的**刚性**既是这套系统可靠的原因，也是它在恶劣天气失灵的原因。§rig（僵硬，同 rigid 僵硬的）
rigorous§The testing was rigorous for four of the nine components and cursory for the rest.§测试对九个部件中的四个是**严格的**，对其余则草草了事。§rig（僵硬）→ 一板一眼
ritualistic§The review has become ritualistic: the same nine questions, the same four answers, every single year.§这项评审已变得**仪式化**——同样的九个问题、同样的四个答案，年年如此。§
rival§Her chief rival for the post wrote her reference, which she did not learn until nine years later.§与她争夺这个职位的主要**对手**为她写了推荐信，而她九年后才知道。§riv（河流，同 river 河）→ 争同一条河用水的人
rivalry§The rivalry between the two laboratories produced four important papers and one very ugly lawsuit.§两家实验室之间的**竞争**产出了四篇重要论文和一场极难看的官司。§
roam§Cattle roam across four parishes here, and the boundaries exist on paper and nowhere else.§牛群在这里**漫游**过四个教区，而边界只存在于纸上。§
robust§The finding is robust: it survives four different analyses and every subset anyone has tried.§这个发现是**稳健的**——它经受住四种不同分析，以及任何人试过的每个子集。§robur（硬木／力量）
rouse§Nothing roused the town until the school was threatened, and then nine hundred people came.§什么也**唤不醒**这座小镇，直到学校受到威胁，然后九百人来了。§
routine§The routine is the safeguard: four checks, in the same order, whether or not anyone thinks they matter.§**例行程序**就是防线——四道检查，同样的顺序，不管有没有人觉得它们要紧。§rout（路线，同 route 路线）
rudimentary§His grasp of the accounts was rudimentary, and he had signed off on nine of them.§他对账目的掌握是**粗浅初步的**，而他签批了其中九份。§rudi（原始／粗糙，同 rude 粗鲁的）
ruffian§The ruffian in the story turns out, in the last four pages, to have been protecting someone.§故事里那个**恶棍**在最后四页显出原来一直在保护某个人。§
rugged§The rugged coast defeated four survey parties, and the map was finished by a fisherman.§这段**崎岖的**海岸挫败了四支测绘队，地图最后由一位渔民完成。§
rustic§The rustic exterior hides a laboratory with nine million pounds of equipment inside it.§这**乡土气的**外观里面藏着一间装有九百万英镑设备的实验室。§rus（乡村）
sacrosanctity§The sacrosanctity of the archive was tested when a minister asked for four files to be removed.§当一位部长要求抽走四份卷宗时，档案的**神圣不可侵犯**受到了考验。§sacr（神圣，同 sacred 神圣的）+ sanct（圣，同 saint 圣人）
sagacious§The most sagacious remark of the evening was a question about who would pay the maintenance.§那晚最**睿智的**一句话，是一个关于谁来付维护费的问题。§sag（敏锐）
sagacity§Her sagacity about people was worth more to the firm than the four qualifications on her wall.§她对人的**洞明**对公司的价值，超过墙上那四张资格证书。§
salient§The salient fact is buried on page nine: the site has flooded four times since 1994.§最**突出的**事实埋在第九页——这块地自 1994 年以来已被淹四次。§sal（跳，同 salmon 鲑鱼）→ 跳出来的
salutary§The failure was salutary: four teams changed their procedures within a month of reading the report.§这次失败是**有益的**——四个团队在读完报告一个月内就改了流程。§salut（健康，同 salute 致敬）
salutation§The salutation was wrong, the address was wrong, and the four facts in the letter were all correct.§**称呼**错了、地址错了，而信里的四个事实全对。§
salvage§They salvaged nine of the four hundred volumes and spent a decade restoring each one.§他们从四百册中**抢救**出九册，花了十年逐一修复。§salv（拯救，同 save 拯救）
salvageable§About four percent of the collection was salvageable, and the rest went into a skip over two days.§藏品中约百分之四**可以抢救**，其余在两天内进了垃圾箱。§
salvo§A salvo of four questions from the back row ended the announcement before it had properly begun.§后排射来的四个问题的**齐射**，让这场宣布还没正式开始就结束了。§
sanctimonious§The sanctimonious editorial was written by a paper that had run the same story four years earlier.§这篇**假道学的**社论出自一家四年前登过同样报道的报纸。§sanct（圣，同 saint 圣人）→ 装出圣人样
sanction§The council sanctioned the demolition in March and, in September, sanctioned the company that carried it out.§议会三月**批准**了拆除，九月又制裁了执行拆除的公司。§sanct（圣／立法，同 saint 圣人）
sanguine§He remained sanguine about the deadline through four missed milestones, which nobody else managed.§连着错过四个节点，他对期限仍**乐观**，这是别人做不到的。§sangui（血）→ 血色好、性情乐观
sarcasm§The sarcasm did not survive translation, and four foreign editions read the passage as sincere.§这份**讽刺**没能在翻译中保留，四个外文版把这段读成了真诚之言。§
sate§Four courses sated nobody, and the kitchen sent out a fifth that nobody had ordered.§四道菜谁也没**吃饱**，厨房又送出第五道，而没人点过。§sat（满足，同 satisfy 满足）
satirize§The play satirizes a planning committee whose four real-life members recognized themselves at once and promptly sued.§这部戏**讽刺**了一个规划委员会，其四位现实中的成员一眼认出自己，随即提起诉讼。§satir（讽刺文）
